title: Meta descriptions were not detected on some assessed pages
businessImpact: Meta descriptions were not detected on some assessed pages, which may reduce control over search-result messaging for those pages; unassessed pages remain unknown.
recommendation: Write a unique 150–160 character description for each important page
verificationMethod: Re-crawl the URLs and confirm descriptions are present.
problem: Meta descriptions were not detected on some assessed pages
impact: Meta descriptions were not detected on some assessed pages, which may reduce control over search-result messaging for those pages; unassessed pages remain unknown.
fix: Write a unique 150–160 character description for each important page
evidenceText: 35 of 247 assessed pages did not have a detected meta description; unassessed pages remain unknown

title: Heading structure is inconsistent
businessImpact: Inconsistent heading structure may reduce semantic clarity and accessibility.
recommendation: Use one descriptive H1 per page with sequential H2 and H3 sections
verificationMethod: Re-crawl and verify heading structure on all pages.
impact: Inconsistent heading structure may reduce semantic clarity and accessibility.
fix: Use one descriptive H1 per page with sequential H2 and H3 sections
evidenceText: 32 assessed pages missing H1; 4 assessed pages with multiple H1s; unassessed pages remain unknown

verificationMethod: Re-crawl and confirm security headers are present in response.
impact: Missing browser protections may weaken technical trust.
